answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ripple graph. Re-attestations are stored in knoll and timber lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 10 dollars and 5 days per identity, which turns a 790 account sybil into a 9 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
